role_in_parent: Transfers the continuous expression on one interval to the discrete surrogate g_n(m).
statement_nl: For every integer n>1, every integer m with 0 <= m <= n-1, and every real t with m/n <= t < (m+1)/n, one has f_n(t) <= g_n(m).

domain_restrictions: n is an integer greater than 1
m is an integer satisfying 0 <= m <= n-1
t is a real number satisfying m divided by n <= t and t < (m+1) divided by n
division m/n and (m+1)/n is interpreted in the reals (so the interval endpoints are real numbers)
statement_semantic_sketch.normalized_claim: For all integers n with n greater than 1, for all integers m with 0 <= m <= n minus 1, and for all real t with m divided by n <= t and t < (m plus 1) divided by n, it holds that f sub n applied to t is less than or equal to g sub n applied to m.

variables.name: n
variables.role: index for the functions f_n and g_n; also sets the range for m and the partition points for t

variables.name: m
variables.role: discrete bin index constrained by 0 <= m <= n-1; input to g_n

variables.name: t
variables.role: continuous variable constrained to a half-open interval [m/n, (m+1)/n); input to f_n

witness_dependencies: No existential witnesses are introduced; all quantified variables are universally quantified and therefore independent of any existential choice
